description: This file defines the CKEditor 5 Style plugin configuration class for Drupal, including methods for building configuration forms, parsing style definitions, and generating plugin configuration data.

classes.name: Style
classes.description: Defines the CKEditor 5 Style plugin configuration, including form building, validation, and dynamic plugin configuration generation.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for style settings, including a textarea for style definitions.

methods.name: getTagAndClasses
methods.description: Extracts the HTML tag and classes from a parsed style element.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates the style configuration form input, checking for valid CSS selectors.

methods.name: parseStylesFormValue
methods.description: Parses multiline style definitions into structured style data, validating CSS selectors.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Saves the style configuration from the form into the plugin's settings.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default empty configuration for styles.

methods.name: getElementsSubset
methods.description: Returns the list of style elements configured.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Generates the configuration array for the CKEditor 5 Style plugin based on current settings.
